_comment: Read by Dev Tools/b_t.py at build time. extra_files are copied next to the exe; hidden_imports are forced into the bundle; extra_exes are helper scripts built as their own self-contained .exe next to the app.

extra_exes.name: Diagnostic Webex listener
extra_exes._why: Runs all day in the background so '@Diagnostics /run' can open the app while it is closed. Needs to be an exe of its own: as a bare .py it only starts on a PC that has Python with requests installed. Console on purpose - the window is the only sign it is alive, and closing it is how you stop it.
